name: Matrix Concepts Holdings Berhad
overview: 今年公司通过子公司 Matrix Concepts (Southern) Sdn Bhd 签署买卖协议，拟以 RM169,313,523 收购位于 Johor Kulai 的约 174.7749 公顷农业地，用于房地产开发储备。此外，公司推进长期激励计划（LTIP，含 ESOS 与 SGP），并续期/新设关联交易股东授权。其他公告主要为股息除权、财报发布及日常关联交易，未披露教育、酒店、医疗等板块的新动态。
overview_en: During the year, the Company's subsidiary Matrix Concepts (Southern) Sdn Bhd entered into sale and purchase agreements to acquire approximately 174.7749 hectares of agricultural land in Kulai, Johor, for RM169,313,523 as land bank for property development. The Company also proposed a long-term incentive plan (LTIP, comprising ESOS and SGP) and sought renewal/new shareholders' mandates for recurrent related party transactions.

segments.name: 房地产开发与建设
segments.note: 今年公司通过子公司签署协议，拟收购位于 Johor Kulai 的农业地作为开发储备。
segments.note_en: During the year, the Company's subsidiary signed agreements to acquire agricultural land in Kulai, Johor, as development land bank.
